findings.detail: The same ATS first lien SOFR loan is present in the main investments schedule and again in an SLP II/member-equity lookthrough schedule, so the extracted CIK-quarter position key is missing schedule or vehicle scope.

rationale: B02 reports 50 duplicate position keys, with ATS as the example. Raw source confirms ATS First Lien Senior Secured Loan SOFR 5.75%, interest rate 9.65%, maturity 7/12/2029 appears in the main investments schedule at table 56 row 5 with market value 11,875 and again in a separate SLP II/member-equity schedule at table 88 row 5 with market value 4,949; table 87 identifies that smaller schedule as SLP II. These are not literal duplicate rows in one source schedule; they are distinct schedule scopes collapsed into the same CIK-quarter position-key space, which is a real structural extraction/classification error.
